input: Search the web for "summer childcare" and school-age summer care for kids and teens in northeast Tennessee near the NC line (Johnson City, Erwin, Greeneville, Newport). Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Coalition for Kids
candidates.note: Free Summer Bridge program with classroom enrichment and local trips; 2026 enrollment confirmed.

candidates.name: Washington County Schools
candidates.note: Summer School Age Child Care for district students in kindergarten–grade 8, June 1–25, 2026.

candidates.name: Unicoi County Family YMCA
candidates.note: Summer day care camps with sports, STEM and other supervised activities.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of Greeneville & Greene County
candidates.note: School-age summer programs serving kindergarten–grade 12; new Greeneville facility opened in July 2026.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of Johnson City / Washington County
candidates.note: Extended-hour summer programming includes academic activities to prevent summer learning loss.

candidates.name: Johnson City Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 full-day summer camps include Jump Start JC, June–July, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: 2026 Renaissance Child day camps for grades 1–6 with hands-on learning and creative activities.
